To add a download button to WeChat Channels, Lumiven installs its root certificate and temporarily routes the current user’s system proxy through a local service.

While connected, traffic from other apps that use the system proxy also passes through this local service. Disconnecting or exiting restores the previous proxy settings. Lumiven does not install a network driver.

This applies only to the current Windows user and requires no administrator privileges. If Windows requests certificate installation confirmation, review and confirm it to continue. Reopen WeChat Channels after enabling downloads.
